legendTitle: The same symbols now refer to image-token rows
provenance: An exact, hand-chosen one-head worksheet uses a 4×4 grayscale image and two-number rows. No model or photo download is needed. LayerNorm and feed-forward sublayers appear in the full architecture, not in the numerical worksheet. Class A and B are arbitrary output labels, not trained image categories.
footer: Patch embeddings supply the rows; attention computes their contextual updates.
